projects.subtitle: CHAMPAGNE HURET COLAS
paragraphs: Creation of Champagne Huret Colas’ visual identity, designed to express the House’s distinctive positioning. A project focused on typography, line and balance, shaping a visual world that feels modern, refined and distinctive.
imageAlts: bottle with white and blue label

projects.subtitle: CHAMPAGNE EMELISE MENETRIER
paragraphs: Creation of Champagne Emelise Menetrier’s visual world. An art direction inspired by The Little Prince, telling a gentle and poetic story.
The project also extends into animation, bringing this world to life through movement on the House’s website.
imageAlts: second view of the illustrated box

projects.subtitle: PERSONAL PROJECT
paragraphs: Creation of an original illustration for a wine bag designed to carry an opened or unopened bottle. An elegant and approachable visual world adapted across several formats. The signature “take happiness with you” is intended primarily for use outside France in accordance with the Évin law.

projects.subtitle: CHAMPAGNE VADIN PLATEAU
paragraphs: An illustration proposal for the Coteaux Champenois Vadin Plateau label, inspired by a botanical world. Meticulous drawing conveys a thoughtful approach to viticulture, attentive to the living world, and gives the cuvée a sensitive, natural and elegant identity.

projects.subtitle: CHAMPAGNE ADAM MEREAUX
paragraphs: Creation of the packaging for Champagne Adam Mereaux’s 2018 vintage 100% Chardonnay cuvée. The design focuses on materiality, combining embossing with micro-perforated hot foil for a textured, almost leather-like result. An approach designed to reveal the wine’s richness while asserting a strong and tactile visual identity.

projects.subtitle: CHAMPAGNE-INSPIRED ILLUSTRATIONS
paragraphs: A collection of illustrations exploring the world of champagne through different styles and applications. Some began as personal pieces, while others were created for communication materials, covers and product design.

projects.subtitle: LAUNCH - 2025 HARVEST COLLECTION
paragraphs: Management of the 2025 Harvest collection launch, from product selection through to market release. Delivery of sales support materials (website, brochure, samples, sales kit and editorial calendar) and organisation of a launch event in the form of a fashion show, with on-site sales and activities. Participant feedback was extremely positive.
imageAlts: Love is in this verre tote bag

projects.subtitle: LAUNCH - 2025 CHRISTMAS COLLECTION
paragraphs: Launch of the 2025 Christmas collection, from product definition to the overall art direction based on the concept ‘What if Father Christmas were a winegrower?’. Several clients took part in the photo shoot. Creation of a dedicated event: a dinner in a fully staged venue. A project designed as a complete experience.
imageAlts: Christmas portrait with a bottle and a dog
black flask presented with a white glove
black gift box presented on a white glove
Christmas candle unveiled under a cloche

projects.subtitle: SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT
paragraphs: Social media management showcasing client projects and catalogue products. Definition of an editorial calendar (two posts per week), support during photo shoots, AI prompt expertise and photo retouching. In one year, the agency’s Instagram community doubled organically.

about.title: About me
about.text: Rooted in the world of champagne, I work at the intersection of communication, creation and marketing, with an approach that is both strategic and operational. I enjoy bringing meaning to projects and creating memorable experiences. Today, I want to put this vision at the service of the wine industry by developing useful, tangible projects that meet its current expectations.

items.description: Management of communication and launches through an effective multichannel strategy that doubled the Instagram community in one year. Organisation of events and trade shows, team management and showroom operations.
Content strategy development to increase awareness and generate leads, including SEO-focused copywriting to improve the organic search presence of several websites.
Design and production of bespoke illustrations for B2C clients, with a tailored creative approach adapted to each client’s expectations and visual world.
Social media strategy management, creation of SEO-optimised editorial content and management of marketing workflows through HubSpot.
